name: Soy Luna
description: Luna Valente lives with her family in Cancún, Mexico. She goes to school, has her own group of friends, has a job, and loves to skate. However, her life changes when her parents are given a job offer that moves them to Buenos Aires, Argentina. There she finds a new skating rink (named Jam & Roller), learns freestyling, makes new friends, and even falls in love.

videos.title: Soy Luna: The Journey
videos.overview: You accompanied us throughout the entire journey of Luna, Matteo, Ámbar, Simón, and all the kids from Jam & Roller. You cried, laughed, sang with us, and even skated across the rink. Now discover the journey of the cast behind the characters.

videos.title: Un accidente, sobre ruedas (Parte 1)
videos.overview: There is rebellion in the scooter team: Matteo asks Ramiro to return, while Ámbar Delfi is putting pressure on the team to leave the team. Luna and Mónica are desperate as they realize that Luna's medal has disappeared. At the same time, Alfredo is getting closer and closer to the truth, and Pedros and Nicos quarreling about Eva, endangering the entire team.
